name: Handball under pressure
summary: Quick handball release with a defender closing in.
setup: Partner starts 5 m away and closes as soon as you receive the ball.
coaching_points: Eyes up before you receive;Punch through the ball, don't throw it;Step across the tackler's line

name: Set shot under fatigue
summary: Set shots straight after a sprint, to simulate match fatigue.
setup: Sprint 20 m, receive a pass, play on, then set shot from 35 m.
coaching_points: Reset your breathing before starting the routine;Same pre-shot routine regardless of fatigue;Track makes out of 10

name: Contested marking technique
summary: Technique work on strong hands and body positioning at the fall of the ball, no live contest.
setup: Partner throws a high ball; you work on timing the jump and shielding with the body.
coaching_points: Take off from one step, not two;Punch through with the hip extended;Keep eyes on the ball through contact
